facts.fact: The technical adviser to the minister for local authorities said at the NEKKAL programme's final steering committee on 29 June 2026 that the programme had interconnected 400 civil registry centres; the document does not say by what link or who pays for it.
facts.system: interconnexion des centres d'état civil (programme NEKKAL)

facts.fact: The ministry's adviser gives 400 civil registry centres interconnected under NEKKAL as of 29 June 2026, a count of centres with no total and no count of communes.
facts.system: interconnexion des centres d'état civil (programme NEKKAL)

facts.fact: APS reports that NEKKAL, the programme that interconnected 400 civil registry centres, is financed by the European Union and executed by Civipol and Enabel with the national civil registry agency (ANEC), and held its final steering committee on 29 June 2026.
facts.system: interconnexion des centres d'état civil (programme NEKKAL)
